name: game_loop
character: a seamless loop for a game or an app: it repeats end to start, so the arrangement is short, cyclic and the seam matters more than a final cadence
why: a shipped starting point for `gate_profiles.py new <name> --from game_loop`: the figures are starting values chosen for the genre structure, not measurements of a piece; measure with scripts/rca.py and state the real figures in the project profile

pattern.flags_max.reason: a loop is repeated by design; the seam and the layers carry the variation

pattern.velocity_flat.reason: a game loop is mixed to sit under play; a narrow level range is a requirement, not a flaw
